Implemented contract:
- Exact STRATA_SERVE_FIRST_ROW_CAPTURE=1 only; absent/0/01/true/other values OFF. Enabled requires explicit nonempty STRATA_SERVE_FIRST_ROW_DIR resolving to an existing directory. OFF has no capture row allocation/copy/IO; empty sink/path and empty per-request vector are host objects only.
- Intentionally specialized to the requested actual phase path: existing phase-cache + head-lease required, and their existing strict startup guard remains authoritative. No alternative standalone route or teacher forcing/token emission changes. Ordinary serial serve, single GPU, spec1, no batch/pipeline/MTP/suffix/lookup/prompt cache/conversation cache/disk/adaptive swaps or positive adapt_async; dump-logits collision rejected. o.max_new startup default is not mistaken for serve's effective request max_new.
- Request parse rejects max_new != 1, GENI, pin, PCIe. Existing phase_fresh_admission checks actual healthy owner/session geometry, zero cache capacities, live/checkpoint/parked/reuse/slots/split/failed state and valid bounded token IDs. Capture reservation occurs only after ordinary context/token admission, before begin_gen.
- Additional actual resume/from_live/live_ok/checkpoint/tail/conversation/disk guard immediately before session_zero. Existing checked zero, begin_gen and successful_prompt execute unchanged. successful_prompt completes workspace retirement, head reload and phase map/fill/publish before serial decode.
- Effective serial window guard immediately before Verifier::run: first_window, produced_n0, request max_new1, T1, p=P-1, resume0, no use_mtp/from_sfx/chain, retired phase workspace and nonfailed cycle. Head/window contents and emitted tokens untouched.
- Actual Verifier::copy_logits(0) after successful run/commit and nonfinite_hit check; FP32 whole vocabulary, independent finite-value check. Copy/allocation exception or false result triggers existing phase_fatal/_Exit without unwinding uncertain GPU/DMA owners. COPIED stderr records request index/P/position/row/T/reuse and complete=0.
- Row held until ordinary last wait_commit and successful phase_cycle.complete_gen. Produced exactly1/no cancellation/nonfinite/nan_flush/stop/empty-row is required before publish. No file for unsuccessful first-window/phase completion.
- Host-only sink bounds vocabulary to int32 and each row/total budget to64MiB, at most64 request attempts; reserves attempted bytes without restoring on failure. Checked multiplication uses bounded int32 vocab in uint64, so no integer overflow. Requires IEEE FP32 sizeof4.
- Layout int32 vocab/int32 rows1/FP32 row. fopen wbx creates request-N.partial exclusively (including symlink collision refusal), checks each fwrite count, fflush, fclose and final size. On success create_hard_link publishes request-N.bin atomically without overwrite. Existing final or partial rejects. Failed partial stays incomplete; successful partial is intentionally retained as a second link for Main's serialized hash/deletion manifest. A hard-link-supporting output filesystem is required. No fsync/crash-durability claim. A private directory is an operator contract; protection against concurrent malicious directory replacement is not claimed.
- COMPLETE stderr gives request index, actual P, predicted P-1, source row0, actual reuse0, vocab, bytes, file and diagnostic_only1. Diagnostic capture is excluded from speed measurements. Completion is a capture event, never a quality PASS.

CPU fixture SOURCE added to existing phase_cache_owner_test:
- Exact opt-in values, valid row byte arithmetic, invalid/overflow/overbudget vocabulary and active reservation refusal.
- Production shared fwrite/flush/close routine with injected header short write, payload short write, flush failure and close failure; always flush/close even after write failure.
- Linux private mkdtemp actual dump layout/readback; wrong-size/NaN/Inf refuses without final; exclusive partial collision; 64 successful tiny rows then65th refused; independently pre-existing final no-overwrite. Fixture's scoped cleanup concerns only its own exclusive /tmp subtree, performed only when Main later runs it.
- No fixtures were executed. Copy fault behavior is caller _Exit logic, not a fake CPU GPU-success claim.

Main review/test plan (serial, existing measurement lock and budgets):
1. Review startup guard at generate's phase-cache block, request admission immediately before phase begin_gen, actual resume guard before session_zero, first serial effective window guard before run, copy after nonfinite check, and publication after wait_commit/complete_gen. Confirm phase/head-lease specialization matches desired qualification scope.
2. Run appropriate existing full source lints and free/contrib-llvm builds with required warning policy. Run existing CPU phase_cache_owner_test (including new source fixture), then ASan/UBSan CPU fixture if appropriate. NVIDIA path unverified absent target hardware. No contrib-icpx validation requested.
3. In fresh private directories, serially exercise absent/0/01/true flags with no diagnostic files and unchanged ordinary GEN/LP behavior; exact1 missing DIR; nonphase/no-head-lease/spec>1/suffix>0/lookup>0/MTP/batch/pipeline/cache/adapt/dump conflicts. Effective request GEN2 rejected before phase transition; valid GEN1 afterward should remain possible.
4. Owned supervised phase service, explicit qualified settings and exact1 DIR, prompt P>=2, GEN1: pin copy position P-1, source row0, effectiveT1/no reuse; verify head reload and successful phase markers precede capture and COMPLETE follows checked completion. Compare .bin int32 header and exact size8+4*vocab against stderr, verify finite FP32 row and hash. Exercise ordinary LP request on same first row to ensure output unchanged. Two fresh GEN1 prefixes exercise independent reset and completion; 65th/budget exhaustion must fail closed rather than masquerade as complete.
5. Exercise output collisions (existing partial, final, symlink), unwritable directory/write/flush/close faults under CPU sink harness or controlled filesystem, plus GPU checked-copy fault only via reviewed owned fault mechanism. Missing COMPLETE or abnormal exit means incomplete diagnostic. No successful-capture status on cancelled/nonfinite/faulted request.
6. Main-managed external serve producer must associate every prefix prompt+follow[:i], target, P-1 row, request identity/hash, environment/source/binary and closed supervised process/fault receipt. Comparator/adapter registration requires separate Main review; this implementation does not alter existing producer registry/schema or assert producer authenticity.
7. Serialize cleanup after run close and absence of owned processes; keep named current comparison .bin files, retire duplicate successful partial links only after verified hash/manifest. Failed partial retain only when named unresolved consumer adds evidence. No active file cleanup here.

Unverified: all builds/lints/tests, platform behavior of wbx/hard links, actual GPU copy/phase lifecycle and fault tests, numerical/reference equality, full fixed-history NLL/perplexity, full quality, physical256K, RESTORE, and speed. All remain unproven. No model argmax is fed into subsequent fixed-prefix history; external controller owns full sequence semantics. This source implementation alone is not a full quality pass.
